purpose: Dual Reviewer Critique and VerificationResult validation, provenance, disposition, and missing, unrelated, malformed, or stale Context failure behavior.

cases.input: A valid target and complete cited graph that supports the material content.
cases.expect: One independently validated Critique and one independently validated VerificationResult with complete shared provenance and an explicit disposition.

cases.input: An unsupported material Claim or Proposal.
cases.expect: An explicit issue disposition that prevents silent downstream eligibility.

cases.input: A materially contradictory Claim or Proposal.
cases.expect: An explicit issue disposition that prevents silent downstream eligibility.

cases.input: A missing or unrelated target or cited graph.
cases.expect: Fail closed with no candidate mutation and no Approval or publication state.

cases.input: A result missing either typed output or required provenance.
cases.expect: Reject the result without appending a partial H1 Reviewer Handoff.

cases.input: The target or Board revision is stale.
cases.expect: Fail closed with no current Board mutation.

workerRule: The implementation Worker may read this Oracle but must not modify it. Any mismatch is REPLAN_REQUIRED.
